title: Classify (ML)
description: Train an interpretable feature-based classifier on real measured cells, with c1 as the negative control and c2 as the positive control.
objectives: Map the first two plate columns to negative and positive controls.
Review feature preparation, plate correction, validation, importance, output, plot, and runtime categories.
Configure leakage-aware hyperparameter search and understand what Run will write.
prerequisite: Complete Measure so the project contains measurements/measurements.db, and define biologically valid control wells before fitting.
